body: character reference sheet T-POSE, straight-on front view, arms outstretched horizontally like an airplane / scarecrow -- a chibi voxel-block toy figure of a supreme royal knight, BOTH ARMS RAISED STRAIGHT OUT TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height, elbows fully straight, a large visible gap between each arm and the torso, both blocky hands open with fingers spread, nothing held, fully visible in frame. Big blocky head, short stubby blocky body, made of assembled rectangular blocks, every part a flat rectangular block with hard 90-degree edges, bold thick black outline stroke around every edge like a toy render, NO smooth curves, NO soft gradients. Legs straight, shoulder-width apart. Matte dark navy-charcoal blocky armor with thick GOLD trim blocks, a blocky gold crown block worn over a blocky helmet with a flat glowing gold visor rectangle, small blocky black wing shapes flat against the back (not overlapping the arms), a gold scepter block strapped flat to the back. Flat toy-voxel render style, single flat even lighting, plain flat grey background, generous empty margin so nothing is cropped, no text, no logos, no watermark
